1464773063933763586 [2021-11-28] @AskYatharth 💜 19 🔁 1 [(SEED) type=quote_of_root]
i want to talk about the other side of this, which is how to stop doing frame control https://t.co/DFNYak9lfN
  [Quoting @QiaochuYuan: possibly one of the more important posts you’ll ever read, from ⁦@Aella_Girl⁩  https://t.co/dOohixo2Tr]
↓
1464773067117195265 [2021-11-28] @AskYatharth 💜 7
one of the reasons it’s insidious is because the frame controller can bring up talk of frame control and use that talk to extricate themselves while *continuing to make the other person feel crazy* for reactions they have against the frame
↓
1464773068262240256 [2021-11-28] @AskYatharth 💜 5
and now the frame controller has brought up frame control, so… it couldn’t be that, could it?
↓
1464783219128029185 [2021-11-28] @AskYatharth 💜 24 🔁 1
this is similar to how narcissism is very hard to treat. almost untreatable. what narcissism (on a deeper level) is the fact that you cannot introspect. you can fake it, but you’re always living/performing in a story to other people
↓
1464783220059168768 [2021-11-28] @AskYatharth 💜 16
there’s this inner layer of trauma you want to protect. any attempt to discourse with or treat the person only interacts with them on a story level
↓
1464783220700897283 [2021-11-28] @AskYatharth 💜 5 🔁 1
same with frame control. you can’t get the person to stop if they don’t want to do it. 

you as the frame controller cannot stop by telling any particular story. frame control ~ narcissism in that weaving of a story
↓
1464783223314006019 [2021-11-28] @AskYatharth 💜 10 🔁 1
what frame control is is changing the gradient of the other person’s internal emotional landscaper such that any feelings (like anger in Aella’s article) that don’t fit the frame start feeling really bad to hold. really really icky, and confusing
↓
1464783223964069891 [2021-11-28] @AskYatharth 💜 8
and you know if you let go and simply submit, things become so much easier and smooth. from there, you’ve entered sub space, and you become submissive, and it can be pleasant in its own way
↓
1464783224924561412 [2021-11-28] @AskYatharth 💜 6
but even resistance is productive for the frame controller: if the other person feels anger, then also guilt at feeling anger, this makes them even more confused, and reinforces the idea that…
↓
1464783225566334976 [2021-11-28] @AskYatharth 💜 5
if you “go there”, to the world of internal emotions that contravene the frame, it’s painful & terrifyingly destabilising
↓
1464783226153566217 [2021-11-28] @AskYatharth 💜 5 🔁 1
so the you as frame controller cannot simply [stop frame controlling] by just naming frame control, or saying you might be doing it. you might still be doing frame control
